desc: This video features Gabe Brown and his Keys To Building a Healthy Soil, filmed on Nov. 18th 2014 at the Idaho Center for Sustainable Agriculture's annual symposium.

recs.stt: The Plan to Feed the World by Hacking Photosynthesis
recs.x:
Here's a great talk by Gabe Brown from Idaho using natural, regenerative methods to rebuild soil.

recs.stt: Soil bacteria could improve crop yields, via fungi
recs.x:
I found this presentation[0] by a farmer talking about growing soil to be super interesting. He touches on promoting beneficial fungi as one part of it. He claims that with all the relatively easy techniques he, and other like minded farmers do, that they get high calories per acre than some conventional farmers.

recs.stt: Peru is reviving a pre-Incan technology for water
recs.x:
I saw an interesting farmer presentation on YouTube[1] the other day where he eventually starts talking about how cover crops have improved his land's ability to absorb and retain water. He even includes photos contrasting his neighbor's monoculture fields with his during rain storms.
